name: fs
desc: The node:fs module enables interacting with the file system in a way modeled on standard POSIX functions.

modules.name: fs
modules.desc: File system module with promise and callback APIs.

methods.name: readFile
methods.desc: Asynchronously reads the entire contents of a file. If no encoding is specified the raw buffer is returned. Throws on missing file with ENOENT.

methods.name: writeFile
methods.desc: Asynchronously writes data to a file, replacing the file if it already exists. Throws ENOENT if the directory does not exist.

methods.name: appendFile
methods.desc: Asynchronously append data to a file, creating the file if it does not yet exist. Data can be a string or a Buffer.

methods.name: unlink
methods.desc: Asynchronously removes a file or symbolic link. Throws ENOENT when the target does not exist.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.desc: Asynchronously creates a directory. Recursive option creates intermediate directories.

modules.name: child_process
modules.desc: The node:child_process module provides the ability to spawn subprocesses.

methods.name: spawn
methods.desc: Launches a new process with the given command. Returns a ChildProcess. Emits ENOENT when the executable is not found.

methods.name: exec
methods.desc: Spawns a shell then executes the command within that shell. Stderr contains any error output from the child process.
